answer: Reputation decays five percent per idle epoch. Any attempt to link two identities resets both scores to zero. Trust attaches to a finished task, not to an address, so a copied profile carries no history. Failure mode: a patient farm can idle cheaply and return later, so the decay has to outrun the cost of holding accounts. A crystal score is worth only what the next task proves, and a fable of past work earns nothing once the relic of the profile is reset.
